metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code by perky-team

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A row above the prompt with the context fill, the 5-hour and weekly rate limits with their pace and the time left until each resets, and counts of the agents and background commands at work

plugins.name: task-watch
plugins.description: Watches background commands and agents: a one-line status above the prompt every few minutes, written by a small model, and a wake-up for the main model when the work looks stuck or wrong

plugins.name: machine-monitor
plugins.description: What loads this Linux machine now, in a pane beside the chat and as a skill: load, memory, disk, temperature, optional job queues, and the CPU and memory of each Claude session
